name: The Five Blades — Before the Storm

paranoia_debut.title: The Road
paranoia_debut.narrator: Days pass. The road goes on.
paranoia_debut.text:
You have been traveling for several days.

The four have found a rhythm.

Aryn at the front.
Ikar watching the rear.
Taera stopping to press her palm to the earth in every village you pass.
Vael vanishing and reappearing without warning.

And you.

You walk.

You stare at your black blade.

It absorbs the sunlight.

In the villages people step aside.
They whisper.
They look at you as if you were already the catastrophe.

observer_quatre.title: Watching Them
observer_quatre.text:
They work well together.

Too well.

Gestures they make without speaking.
Looks that seem to mean something you don't understand.

Twelve years together.

You have known them for only a few days.

Aryn says the right things.
Taera smiles at the right moment.
Vael cracks jokes.
Ikar... Ikar often looks at your blade.

Not for long.

Just a second.

Then he looks away.

regarder_lame.title: The Black Blade
regarder_lame.text:
It is cold in your hand.

Even in full sunlight.

You remember how it appeared.

In the ashes of Cendral.
As if it had been waiting for you.

As if all of this had been planned.

The prophecy.
The village.
The four who arrive at just the right moment.

Too neatly timed to be chance.

Or else.

You shake your head.

You push these thoughts away.

For now.

premier_village.title: The Village of Maren
premier_village.text:
The village is called Maren.

Small.
Clean.
Ordinary.

Just like Cendral.

The villagers watch you come in.

They see the four first.

The Four Blades.
The defenders of Aerith.

Some of them bow.

Then they see you.

And the black blade.

The silence changes its nature.

An old woman pulls her child behind her.

A man shuts his door.

Taera rests a hand on your shoulder.

**"Ignore them."**

Easier said than done.

vieille_femme_village.title: The Look
vieille_femme_village.text:
She holds her child close.

She does not take her eyes off you.

No anger.

Just fear.

The kind of fear you feel toward something
you cannot control.

A fire.
A storm.
A bearer of Chaos.

You want to tell her you don't mean any harm.

But Cendral is behind you.

And the words have stuck in your throat
ever since Marek looked at you that way.

taverne.title: The Tavern
taverne.text:
The tavern is warm.

It smells of beer and wood.

The four take their seats.

Taera orders for everyone.
Vael makes the innkeeper laugh.
Aryn studies the menu.
Ikar drinks without a word.

Drinks are served.

Except to you.

The innkeeper sets the bowls down in front of everyone.

Then he looks at you.

Then he walks off without putting anything down in front of you.

Vael slides his bowl toward you without a word.

You don't take it.

prendre_bol.title: The Bowl
prendre_bol.text:
You take it.

Vael pretends not to have noticed.

Aryn too.

Taera smiles into her soup.

Ikar looks outside.

You eat in silence.

It is the first meal since Cendral
where you don't feel separated from them
by something invisible.

Just for the length of a meal.

Then Ikar says:

**"We leave again at dawn."**
**"We have to keep up the training."**

The moment closes.

dehors_taverne.title: Outside
dehors_taverne.text:
Night falls over Maren.

You walk alone down the street.

The houses go dark one by one.

Somewhere in the village
a dog barks.

It stops when you pass.

Even the dogs.

You sit down on a low wall.

The black blade in your hands.

Cold.
Always cold.

premiere_dispute.title: Voices
premiere_dispute.narrator: You can hear their voices from the tavern.
premiere_dispute.text:
The window is ajar.

Voices.

Ikar first.

**"...we can't wait forever..."**

Aryn answers him.
Too low.

**"...the elders were right..."**

The word *elders* comes through clearly.

Then Taera.

**"...but if we make the same mistake as..."**

Vael says something.
Everyone falls silent.

Then Ikar again.

**"...we have to be ready for anything."**

You know that sentence.

You heard it in the ruins of Cendral.

You don't know the rest of the conversation.

But you know that sentence.

ecouter_plus.title: Listening Closer
ecouter_plus.text:
You move closer to the window.

Aryn is speaking now.

**"...we don't have the right to..."**

Ikar cuts in.

**"...if Chaos takes over..."**

**"...that's not what's going to happen..."** says Taera.

**"You can't know that."** Ikar.

Silence.

Vael says something gentle.
You can't make out the words.

But you hear the tone.

The tone of someone trying to soothe.

**"...we have to trust him..."** says Aryn.

**"And what if we're wrong?"** says Ikar.

Another silence.

Long.

No one answers.

lendemain_maren.title: The Next Morning
lendemain_maren.text:
You leave at dawn.

Just as planned.

Ikar leads today.

You walk beside Taera.

She doesn't speak right away.

Then:

**"Did you sleep well?"**

**"Yes."**

You're lying.

She knows it.

She says nothing.

The road goes on.

In your head the sentences keep turning.

*Ready for anything.*
*If Chaos takes over.*
*And what if we're wrong?*

Pieces of a puzzle whose full picture you don't have.

demander_taera.title: The Question
demander_taera.text:
**"I heard your conversation last night."**

Taera stops.

**"What did you hear?"**

**"Ikar saying we have to be ready for anything."**
**"And questions about whether we're wrong."**

She resumes walking.

**"The conversation was about how to help you."**
**"Not about anything else."**

**"And if you can't figure out how to help me?"**

She thinks for a long time.

**"Then we keep looking."**

**"That's all?"**

**"That's already a lot."**

She isn't lying.

You can feel it.

But you also know she isn't telling you everything.

semaines_route.title: The Weeks
semaines_route.text:
They train you.

Aryn teaches you to channel.
Taera teaches you to anchor.
Vael teaches you to scatter.

Ikar teaches you to strike.

He is the one who progresses fastest with you.

Two blades that understand each other.

But the nights are long.

And the sentences keep coming back.

*Ready for anything.*

Every morning you wake up and watch them sleep.

Four familiar faces.

Four people hiding something from you.

entrainement_scene.title: Training
entrainement_scene.text:
Aryn shows you something.

**"Don't focus on what you want to destroy."**
**"Focus on what you want to protect."**

**"It's the same thing."**

**"No."** she says.
**"It's exactly not the same thing."**

You try.

The black blade hums differently.

Less chaos.
More... direction.

Aryn nods.

**"See?"**

For the first time since Cendral —

you see it.

observer_ikar.title: Watching Ikar
observer_ikar.text:
Ikar sleeps with his blade within reach.

Everyone does that.

But Ikar holds his differently.

Like someone getting ready.

Not for an outside attack.

For a decision.

You look at his hand on the hilt.

You think about the night at Cendral.

The scraps of conversation.

*Ready for anything.*

Has he already decided?

Do the others know?

The question hangs unanswered until morning.

deuxieme_dispute.title: The Second Night
deuxieme_dispute.text:
You can hear them again.

This time more clearly.

Ikar and Aryn.

**"...it's not moving fast enough..."** Ikar.

**"...it takes the time it takes..."** Aryn.

**"...the elders said we had to act before..."**

**"The elders also said not to repeat the same mistakes."**

**"The same mistake was waiting too long."**

**"No."** Aryn — her voice changes.
**"The same mistake was not trusting him."**
**"Not reaching out a hand."**
**"That's what killed the four from that time."**

**"And what if this time it's different?"**

**"It's not different."**

**"Aryn."**

**"It's. Not. Different."**

Silence.

entrer_camp.title: Stepping In
entrer_camp.text:
You step into the firelight.

They stop.

Ikar and Aryn look at each other.

**"You weren't sleeping."** says Vael from his side.

**"No."**

Silence.

**"What you were saying..."** you begin.

Aryn cuts you off.

**"We were discussing training strategy."**

**"No, you were talking about me."**

No one answers.

That silence confirms more than any answer could.

rester_obscurite.title: In the Shadows
rester_obscurite.text:
You stay where you are.

In the dark.

The black blade in your hands.

Cold.

*The same mistakes.*
*Reaching out a hand.*
*It's not different.*

The sentences fit together differently depending on how you read them.

One way — Aryn is defending you.

The other way — they have a plan.
A plan you don't know about.
A plan in which you are the subject.

The blade hums faintly.

As if it too is listening.

As if it too understands.

vieux_apparait.title: The Old Man
vieux_apparait.narrator: He is there when you wake up.
vieux_apparait.text:
An old man.

Sitting on a rock by the side of the road.

He hasn't seen you yet.

He is carving something from a piece of wood.

Like Marek.

He looks up as you approach.

He sees your black blade.

He doesn't back away.

He smiles.

**"Ah."** he says simply.
**"I was waiting for you."**

Not said as a threat.

Like someone who has waited a long time
and is relieved the wait is over.

vieux_avec_quatre.title: With the Four
vieux_avec_quatre.text:
You call the four.

They come.

The old man looks them over.

He doesn't change expression.

Ikar puts a hand on his blade.

**"Who are you?"** asks Aryn.

**"Someone who knows things."**
**"About Chaos."**
**"About the prophecy."**
**"About what's being kept from you."**

He looks at you.

Not at the four.

At you.

**"Not everything can be said in front of everyone."**

Ikar takes a step forward.

Taera puts a hand on his arm.

**"Let him speak."**

Vael looks at you.

He isn't smiling.

vieux_identite.title: Erevane
vieux_identite.text:
**"My name is Erevane."**

He puts his knife away.

**"I have studied Chaos my whole life."**
**"Not in the Order's archives."**
**"In the real archives."**
**"The old ones."**
**"The ones they didn't burn."**

**"Burned?"**

**"The Order keeps what suits it."**
**"And forgets the rest."**

He pulls an old book out of his bag.

Worn.
Black cover.

**"There is another prophecy."**
**"Older than the one you know."**

He holds the book out to you.

**"Chaos is not a curse."**
**"It is a gift."**
**"Misunderstood."**
**"Badly taught."**
**"For three hundred years."**

vieux_pourquoi.title: The Question
vieux_pourquoi.text:
Erevane looks at you.

**"Because you need to hear it."**

**"And the four?"**

He hesitates.

Just for a second.

**"The four were trained by the Order."**
**"The Order has its certainties."**
**"Its certainties have been around for three hundred years."**

**"What does that mean?"**

**"It means they help you the way they know how."**
**"Not necessarily the way you need."**

He sets the book down on the rock between you.

**"I'm not asking you to leave them."**
**"I'm only asking you to read."**

vieux_livre.title: The Other Prophecy
vieux_livre.text:
You take the book.

It opens to a marked page.

A prophecy.
A different one.

*"The bearer of Chaos will come from the borderlands.*
*Its blade will absorb the light.*
*And in that absorbed light —*
*it will keep what the world forgot to keep.*
*This is not the end.*
*It is memory."*

You look at Erevane.

**"Who wrote this?"**

**"Someone who saw Caël before he fell."**
**"Someone who believed things could have been done differently."**

**"Why doesn't the Order talk about this?"**

He takes the book back.

**"Because it calls into question everything they have built."**

He tucks the book away.

**"I'll be in the next town."**
**"If you want to know more."**

He stands.
He walks back onto the road.

As if he had all the time in the world.

apres_vieux.title: Afterward
apres_vieux.text:
The four arrive.

Or they have been there all along.

You no longer know.

**"Who was that?"** asks Vael.

**"Someone passing through."**

Aryn looks at you.

Her eyes go to the rock where the old man was sitting.

She says nothing.

Ikar looks down the road in the direction he went.

**"We move on."** he says.

You move on.

But something has changed.

Not them.

You.

tension_monte.title: The Tension
tension_monte.narrator: The days that follow are different.
tension_monte.text:
You look for signs.

In their looks.
In their silences.
In the way Ikar keeps his hand close to his blade.

Sometimes there's nothing.

Sometimes you're not sure.

One evening Aryn sits down beside you.

**"Are you all right?"**

**"Yes."**

**"You're not sleeping."**

**"I'm sleeping."**

**"You don't sleep the way you used to."**

You look at her.

**"How do you know how I used to sleep?"**

She has no answer for that.

She gets up and leaves without a word.

The next morning Vael makes a joke.

Nobody really laughs.

parler_vael.title: Vael
parler_vael.text:
You sit down beside him.

He says nothing for a while.

That's rare for Vael.

**"You met someone on the road."** he says.

**"Someone passing through."**

**"Yeah."**

He watches the fire.

**"You know what I find interesting?"**

**"What."**

**"People who turn up at just the right moment."**
**"When you're alone."**
**"When you're looking for answers."**
**"And who have exactly the answers you're looking for."**

**"And so?"**

**"And so nothing."**
**"I just find it interesting."**

He stands.

**"Good night."**

retrouver_vieux.title: Finding Erevane
retrouver_vieux.text:
You find him in the tavern of the next town.

Just as he said.

He sees you come in.

He pushes a chair toward you.

**"Did you read?"**

**"Yes."**

**"Any questions?"**

**"Many."**

He smiles.

The kind of smile a teacher gives
when they expected exactly that.

**"Good."**
**"That's how it starts."**

He pulls out other books.

Other marked pages.

You talk for a long time.

He listens as much as he speaks.

He never says *you should leave the four.*

But by the end of the conversation
you realize you've only spoken of them
in the past tense.

lame_nuit.title: The Blade's Night
lame_nuit.text:
The black blade lies in front of you.

It drinks in the firelight.

You have been staring at it for an hour.

Erevane's words.
The arguments you overheard.
Ikar's looks.
Aryn's silence.

*Ready for anything.*
*The same mistakes.*
*If Chaos takes over.*

And the prophecy in the book.

*This is not the end.*
*It is memory.*

Two prophecies.
Two readings of the world.

You have to choose which one to believe.

You hear someone move.

ikar_lame_gorge.title: The Blade
ikar_lame_gorge.text:
You feel it before you see it.

The heat.

Ikar's blade, on fire.

Under your throat.

You haven't moved.

You haven't had time.

Or you didn't want to.

You open your eyes.

Ikar is there.

Kneeling.

His blade beneath your throat.

His eyes.

Not anger.

Something much harder than that.

He is trembling slightly.

The blade trembles with him.

ikar_lache.title: He Can't
ikar_lache.text:
Ikar doesn't move.

His blade doesn't move.

But he does nothing.

Seconds.

Long ones.

**"Do it."** you say.

Your own voice surprises you.

Calm.

**"If that's what you have to do."**
**"Do it."**

Ikar closes his eyes.

His blade goes out.

He pulls his hand back.

He stays there.
Head bowed.

**"I couldn't."**

Not said to you.

To himself.

autres_arrivent.title: The Others
autres_arrivent.text:
Aryn is there.

Taera too.

Vael in the shadows.

They saw.

Or heard.

Aryn kneels in front of Ikar.

She speaks to him softly.

You can't hear.

Taera looks at you.

Her eyes shine in the dark.

**"Are you all right?"**

**"Yes."**

Vael is beside you now.

He says nothing.

But he is there.

Ikar stands up.

He looks at you.

**"I'm sorry."**

Two words.

The hardest words you have ever heard him say.

confrontation_finale.title: The Truth
confrontation_finale.narrator: The fire has gone out. Dawn is coming.
confrontation_finale.text:
The five of you sit together.

For the first time since Cendral —
no one is pretending.

Aryn speaks.

**"The spirits told us to be ready for anything."**
**"Ikar took it to mean..."**
**"...the ultimate option."**

**"And you?"** you ask.

**"I understood that we must not repeat Caël."**
**"Caël was alone."**
**"We're not here to watch you."**
**"We're here so you won't be alone."**

Ikar stares at the ground.

**"I thought that if it became too dangerous..."**

**"No."** says Taera.
**"That wasn't the right thing to do."**

**"I know that now."**

Vael looks at the sky as it brightens.

**"Nice way to start the day."**

No one laughs.

But Taera's lips curve into a smile.

choices.text: Don't know what to believe anymore.

choix_final.title: The Crossroads
choix_final.text:
The sun rises.

The four look at you.

Your black blade drinks in the morning light.

Ikar. Aryn. Taera. Vael.

Four faces waiting.

Erevane somewhere on the road.
Another prophecy in your head.

The smoke of Cendral.
The blade under your throat.
The apologies.
The doubts.

Everything is here.

And time keeps passing.

choices.text: Trust them. See it through together.
Leave. Alone. Far from all this.
Find Erevane. Maybe he was right.

chemin_fuite.title: The Flight
chemin_fuite.text: You turn your back and leave.

chemin_manipulation.title: Erevane
chemin_manipulation.text: You set out to find the old man.
